# RAINCLOUD

> RAINCLOUD — a standing hour with an operator who has built the motion. Six clients at a time. Colin Dowling. I won't run your go-to-market for you. I'll teach you exactly what to do (then make sure you run it right).

RAINCLOUD is Colin Dowling. VP Enterprise Sales at GoDaddy. SVP Revenue at Alembic, from seed through a $145M Series B. VP Channel Sales at Liquid Web. Enterprise Sales Director at WP Engine. Three times a VP of Sales, twice a founder. Host of Modern Business Life. Based in Dallas–Fort Worth.

A standing hour every week with someone who has held the VP Sales seat three times and built the motion you're building now. I score your go-to-market against 100 dimensions, we work the gaps in the order that matters, and everything we build is yours.

## The method

Score it. Work it. Re-score it.

- Score it. Your go-to-market against 100 dimensions, each marked pass, partial or fail, ranked by what it's costing you. Delivered with a recorded walkthrough. Nobody scores 100.
- Work it. An hour a week. We review what happened, recalibrate where the plan was wrong rather than the execution, set the week, and spend the last twenty minutes on whichever part of the motion your score says is weakest. Anything we build, we build together on the call.
- Re-score it. Every quarter. The movement is the report.

## How it works

1. The 20 Minute Teardown. Free. Forty of the hundred dimensions, scored from public sources only, nothing needed from you. A recorded walkthrough and the scorecard, ending with two or three things to go and do right now for immediate impact. Book it at https://calendly.com/30minutechat/20-minute-go-to-market-w-colin
2. The 100-Point Scorecard. $5,000. The full score, including the sixty dimensions that need a look inside. Five business days. Buy it on its own, or let it take month one of the engagement at no extra cost.
3. The Standing Hour. $4,500 a month. Eleven sessions a quarter, same slot every week. Office hours twice a week in 30-minute blocks. Three-month minimum if you started with the Scorecard, six if you didn't.
4. The Milestone Analysis. At the end of your first term: your score re-run, what you committed to against what you actually did, and a straight recommendation. Keep building at $4,500, or move to maintenance at $2,500 every other week. Sometimes the recommendation is that I've taken you as far as I can, and I'll tell you that too.

One price. I don't discount it, and there isn't a cheaper version.

The 100-point framework is published in full and free to download. What you're buying isn't the list — it's the scoring, and the order the findings come back in.

## Who it is for

- You own the business, or you may as well — the number is yours either way.
- Revenue somewhere between $1M and $25M, B2B.
- Your marketing is you, or one person, or an agency you're not sure about.
- Your sales team is you, or you and a couple of others.
- You intend to run this yourself. You're not looking to hand it over.

Not for you if you want it done for you, want a guarantee on pipeline, have a sales team that needs managing rather than a motion that needs designing, or won't do the homework (two or three things a week, every week).

Six clients. When it's full, it's full.

## Results

- AgentPress: from 7 to 25 qualified meetings a month, in 45 days. "The real secret sauce has been hiring Colin Dowling and RAINCLOUD, who helped us go from 7 meetings a month to more than 25 in a single month." — Andy Walters, Founder + CEO, AgentPress
- 1905 New Media: digital services from $4M to $11M over two years.

Both of them did the work. I just made sure it was the right work, in the right order.

## What RAINCLOUD is not

Not an agency, not a done-for-you service, not a SaaS product, and not a fractional CRO who runs your revenue function. I don't run your outbound, write your content, or manage your campaigns. I don't build or maintain anything between sessions. I don't manage your reps. I don't book meetings or carry a number on your behalf. And I don't guarantee a revenue outcome, because the work is yours and so is the result.
